verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's own README lists Docker as a first-party way to run it and points to dedicated Docker documentation, so running the runtime in a container is an official, documented path. The pack only shows the pointer, not the contents of that documentation. Missing for 10: details of image variants (CPU/CUDA/server), version-pinning for reproducibility, GPU passthrough guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of container deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: Run with Docker - see our [Docker documentation](docs/docker.md)
